# Verkada Info Hub

> > Comprehensive technical resource for Verkada's cloud-based physical security platform, covering video surveillance, access control, IoT sensors, and AI-powered analytics.

This site provides in-depth guides, technical specifications, and best practices for Verkada's unified security ecosystem, including camera systems (dome, bullet, PTZ), access control with RFID/NFC authentication, environmental monitoring sensors (SV11), and AI video analytics (Helix). Content covers installation, configuration, and integration of physical security technologies for smart buildings.

## Key Topics

- Verkada unified security platform
- Cloud-based video surveillance and CCTV
- AI video analytics and Helix
- RFID and NFC access control
- IoT environmental sensors (SV11)
- IP ratings (IP65, IP66, IP67) and IK10 vandal resistance
- License plate recognition (LPR)
- Power over Ethernet (PoE) standards
- Smart building integration
- Physical security and perimeter protection
- Air quality and vape detection monitoring
- Video compression (H.264/H.265)
- Access control systems (AC41)
- Visitor management systems (VMS)

## Platform Overview

- [Verkada - Information on Security Camera Systems and Video Surveillance Technology](https://info.verkada.com/surveillance-features/secure-remote-access): Homepage guide to Verkada security systems and surveillance technology
- [Smart Building Security | Integrated Surveillance Systems](https://info.verkada.com/smart-buildings/surveillance-and-security-camera-systems): Unified security platform integrating AC41 access and SV11 sensors
- [Video Surveillance Systems: A Complete Guide | Verkada](https://info.verkada.com/security-cameras/video-surveillance): Complete guide to video surveillance from CCTV to cloud systems
- [AI Video Analytics | Verkada](https://info.verkada.com/surveillance-features/ai-video-analytics): Verkada Helix AI analytics for real-time threat detection and LPR

## Security Camera Systems

- [Security Cameras](https://info.verkada.com/security-cameras/wifi-camera): Overview of IP camera types including dome and bullet cameras
- [The Pros & Cons of Dome Cameras | Overview, Types, Features](https://info.verkada.com/security-cameras/dome-camera): Dome camera buyer guide covering IK10, IP65 ratings and features
- [The Pros & Cons of Bullet Cameras | Overview, Types, Features](https://info.verkada.com/security-cameras/bullet-camera): Bullet camera guide with IP65-67 ratings and LPR capabilities
- [PTZ vs. Fisheye vs. Multi-Sensor Cameras | Pros & Cons](https://info.verkada.com/compare/ptz-vs-fisheye-vs-multi-sensor-security-cameras): Comparison guide for PTZ, fisheye, and multi-sensor camera types
- [Security Camera Optics: Varifocal vs Fixed Lenses](https://info.verkada.com/security-cameras/varifocal-vs-fixed-lenses): Comparison of varifocal and fixed lens optical zoom capabilities

## Access Control Systems

- [Door Access Systems](https://info.verkada.com/door-access-systems): Cloud-based access control guide with RFID/NFC authentication
- [Guide to Building Security Access Control and Entry Systems](https://info.verkada.com/smart-buildings/door-entry-and-access-systems): Complete guide to access control systems with RFID and smart locks
- [What is RFID and NFC Access Control | All You Need To Know](https://info.verkada.com/door-access-systems/rfid-vs-nfc-access-control-guide): Technical comparison of RFID vs NFC for mobile access control
- [Office Visitor Management System | Verkada](https://info.verkada.com/visitor-management-systems/office): Office VMS guide with access control integration features

## IoT and Environmental Monitoring

- [IoT Smart Sensor Technology](https://info.verkada.com/iot-smart-sensors): IoT sensor guide for smart building environmental monitoring
- [Environmental Sensors: Air Quality Monitoring](https://info.verkada.com/smart-buildings/iot-smart-sensors): Guide to Verkada SV11 IoT sensors for air quality and safety monitoring
